description: This file defines the NodeId class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, representing network node identifiers with support for various address types, including IPv4, IPv6, domain sockets, netlink, Bluetooth, and packet sockets. It includes methods for constructing, comparing, and querying node addresses, as well as related classes like IPNode for IP-specific functionality.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node identifier supporting multiple address families and protocols, with methods for address manipulation and comparison.

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Derived from NodeId, adds IP-specific features such as subnet masking and broadcast address calculation.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns additional information based on the socket type, such as destination address or access rights.

methods.name: Rights
methods.description: Returns access rights for domain sockets.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the address family type of the node.

methods.name: PortNumber
methods.description: Gets or sets the port number associated with the node.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the node has a valid address type.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the node is empty (uninitialized).

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the socket address structure based on the address family.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Gets or sets the hostname associated with the node.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the host address.

methods.name: QualifiedName
methods.description: Returns a fully qualified name for the node.

methods.name: IsLocalInterface
methods.description: Checks if the node is a local interface.

methods.name: IsAnyInterface
methods.description: Checks if the node represents any interface.

methods.name: IsMulticast
methods.description: Checks if the node address is multicast.

methods.name: DefaultMask
methods.description: Returns the default subnet mask for the address type.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two NodeId objects for equality.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Compares two NodeId objects for inequality.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Returns the broadcast address for IP nodes.
